description:
Magic Media is a pioneering media, entertainment and tech group powered by creativity and innovation. We have a physical presence in 15 countries and expertise in the areas of art, animation, cybersecurity, game development, software development, VFX and video production amongst others. We work with leading developers and publishers within the games and tech industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts.

 

We're looking for an iGaming Math Developer who is self-motivated, goal-orientated, and a strong team player. The ideal candidate will have a strong mathematical background and previous professional experience designing and implementing math models for iGaming titles such as slots. We are looking for someone who is passionate about game math and who is willing to work with game designers, artists, and engineers to build awesome games.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

●     Design and implement math models for slot and casino games, including base game, bonus features, and multipliers.

●     Tune RTP, volatility, hit frequency, and max win to meet design goals and regulatory requirements.

●     Build simulations and tools to validate results across billions of spins.

●     Produce math documentation, PAR sheets, and reports for certification and clients.

●     Collaborate with game designers, front-end developers, and QA to ensure the math is implemented accurately in the final game.

●        Strong mathematical foundation in probability, statistics, and combinatorics.

●        Proven previous experience as a math developer or game mathematician in iGaming (slots, crash, or other casino games).

●        Experience designing and tuning RTP, volatility, hit frequency, and max-win targets.

●        Experience running large-scale simulations to validate models.

●        Familiarity with iGaming certification and regulatory math requirements.

●        Fluent in English.

 

DESIRABLE PLUSES:

●     Experience with Python for simulation, data analysis, and tooling.

●     Experience with Stake Engine math SDK or similar game-math frameworks.

●     Experience with other languages such as Rust, C++ or JavaScript/TypeScript.

●     Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (NumPy, pandas, Jupyter or similar).

●     Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or equivalent.

●     Project based remote position.

●     An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of engaging projects.

●     Be part of an international Group with offices worldwide.

●     Career growth and development.

●     Working closely with a team of like-minded people in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

●     Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities.

●     Flexible working hours.

●     An inclusive culture and open communication.

 

At Magic Media, our passion lies in gaming. Our vision is to create and deliver engaging and interesting games for our clients. We can deliver this high-quality work on any platform, whether it be on a console, PC, or mobile. We know that reputation and results go hand-in-hand. Therefore, we work hard to find experts and talented creators to deliver the best results.
